title: dxn actors
description: Editor aid for actors.json: the roles that do work against the model, each declaring what it records: evidence of one kind, such as a design agent's designs, and the checks whose results it may record. An actor is a role, not a person. The dimensions compiler is the authority: it also checks that the checks are declared in types.json.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

evidence.description: The kind of evidence it records, such as design. An actor without it records no evidence.

source.description: What its evidence must be: frames in a pen.dev file (pen.dev), fingerprinted by what each frame shows, or any file (file), fingerprinted as a whole. Only for an actor that records evidence.

checks.description: The checks whose results it may record.

name.description: Non-blank, without leading or trailing whitespace or control characters.
